row.notes: Read in full: finds the current event (id from [this+0x10]+1000 +0xadc/+0xae4) in list [this+0x40]+0x70 (0xa0-byte records); returns 0 if none or if enough time is left. If no active phase or phase 2 and the time before start is < [..+0x3c8]+0x580: logs 'event session is about to start, tell the player session is full' and returns 4; other phases log 'event session has started ...' and return 4.
